title: Sheehan gets an injunction against the Scientology grand jury subpoenas

tellings.quote: me again and I went up to New York CU I'm admitted in the southern district and I got an injunction shutting them down

plain: Sometime in the 1970s, a lawyer named Dan Sheehan says, he stopped a grand jury's subpoenas against the Church of Scientology. A grand jury is a panel that weighs criminal charges, and a subpoena is an order to hand over evidence or testify. Sheehan tells Michels he did it himself: he went up to New York, where he was allowed to practise in the federal court for the Southern District, and "got an injunction shutting them down," an injunction being a court order to stop. If true, it shows how much one lawyer could do against a federal investigation.
